2608.05857.title: Mapping Similarity Spaces across Embedding Models with Synthetic Query Probing
2608.05857.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems rely on similarity scores to retrieve relevant content, yet scores are not directly comparable across embedding models due to differing geometric properties, complicating model migration and limiting threshold reuse. We study how similarity scores can be related by learning mappings between score distributions rather than embeddings. We introduce Synthetic Query Probing, generating queries from documents to create controlled query-chunk pairs, enabling large-scale, reference-free analysis of cross-model similarity behavior. We evaluate the approach on multiple embedding configurations and learn score conversion functions using linear, isotonic, and quantile mappings. Experiments on SciFact and a proprietary corpus show that while models largely agree on rankings, their absolute scores exhibit systematic distortions. Learned mappings partially align these spaces and improve threshold portability, with isotonic regression performing best. Our results highlight the need for cross-model calibration and position Synthetic Query Probing as a scalable framework for analyzing embedding comparability.
2608.05857.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成系統依賴相似性分數來檢索相關內容，然而，由於嵌入模型之間的幾何特性不同，分數無法直接比較，這使得模型遷移變得複雜並限制了閾值的重用。我們研究了如何通過學習分數分佈之間的映射來將相似性分數相關聯，而不是嵌入。我們引入了合成查詢探測，從文檔生成查詢以創建受控的查詢-區塊對，從而實現大規模、無參考的跨模型相似性行為分析。我們在多個嵌入配置上評估該方法，並使用線性、等單調和分位數映射學習分數轉換函數。在SciFact和一個專有語料庫上的實驗顯示，儘管模型在排名上大致一致，但它們的絕對分數卻顯示出系統性的扭曲。學習到的映射部分對齊這些空間並改善閾值的可攜性，其中等單調回歸表現最佳。我們的結果突顯了跨模型校準的必要性，並將合成查詢探測定位為分析嵌入可比性的可擴展框架。
